visual_prior_specs.name: bar_projection_guide
visual_prior_specs.content_description: An overlay on the provided bar chart demonstrating how to read the value of bar C by projecting a horizontal line from its top edge to the y-axis.
visual_prior_specs.draw_instructions: Draw a distinct colored (e.g., red) dashed horizontal line starting exactly from the top-center of bar C and extending leftward until it intersects the vertical y-axis. Add a small colored dot at the exact intersection point on the y-axis. Highlight the outline of bar C in the same color.
visual_prior_specs.visual_rationale: Visually demonstrates the spatial alignment and horizontal projection required to map a bar's height to a numerical axis, establishing the geometric convention for reading chart values.
visual_encodings: Colored dashed line = horizontal projection path
Colored dot = intersection point on the y-axis
Colored outline = target bar being measured
text_exclusions: Do not write the actual numerical value on the image
Do not add textual explanations of the steps

text_to_visual_binding: The 'target bar' in text corresponds to the highlighted bar in the prior.
The 'horizontal projection' corresponds to the dashed line.
The 'intersection point' corresponds to the dot on the y-axis.
task_binding_rules: Apply the projection technique shown in the prior to the specific bar requested in the task.
anti_leakage_rules: Do not hardcode the value of bar C from the prior as the answer for future tasks.
The prior is a generic guide; always read the value from the task's specific chart and requested category.
Do not treat floating numeric annotations as axis evidence unless the task explicitly asks for annotation text.

usage_constraints: Assumes the chart has a linear y-axis.
Assumes the chart is oriented vertically (bars grow upwards).
If an annotation conflicts with the projected axis value, prefer the projected axis value.
